decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions the shop front would not result in harm to the appearance of the property or the wider area, and would provide satisfactory access.  This is in accordance with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.1.8 (Access and Facilities for People with Disabilities), S.4.2 (Shop Front Design), S.4.4 (Access to Shopping Facilities), and Supplementary Guidance 'Think Access'.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

(Reason.  To accord with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990)

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

(Reason.  To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission)

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the information contained within the application the internal widths of each of the door openings to the entrance shall be a minimum of 900mm and permanently retained as such.

Reason:  In order to ensure that there is satisfactory access for people with disabilities.
